provenance.revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated side-view pixel-art game prop for an exact 96 x 32 runtime texture
Primary request: One sparse, asymmetrical ceiling-mounted funerary frieze. Build it from a single uneven corroded iron rail, exactly three offset broken hanging rings, exactly two very short torn burial-ribbon streamers, and only a few thin web bridges.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background; no depicted environment
Subject: a low-profile horizontal funerary frieze intended to attach flush to a ceiling; the rail is irregular and corroded, with the three incomplete rings spaced unevenly and hanging only slightly beneath it; the two ribbon scraps are short and torn, subordinate to the rail; a few delicate web strands bridge small gaps
Style/medium: modern pixel-art game asset; deliberate blocky pixel clusters, crisp hard-edged forms, selective anti-aliasing only, compact shading, broad value groups, strong readable silhouette; clearly pixel art, not painted or photorealistic
Composition/framing: exact 3:1 landscape composition; one complete isolated subject centered with comfortable transparent margin on every side; show the entire subject without cropping; strict side view; keep total silhouette shallow and low-profile, suitable for reduction and quantization to 96 x 32 pixels
Color palette: restrained funerary iron palette, charcoal-black, oxidized brown, muted rust, small dull gray highlights; ribbons muted desaturated grave-cloth tones
Materials/textures: corroded pitted iron expressed through sparse large pixel clusters; torn cloth edges simplified enough to survive reduction
Constraints: exactly one prop; exactly one uneven iron rail; exactly three offset broken rings; exactly two very short torn ribbon streamers; only a few thin web bridges; no text, no watermark; no cast shadow; no floor, ground plane, scenery, border, or frame; subject must remain legible at gameplay scale where the player hitbox is 32 px wide by 64 px tall
Avoid: repeating chain scallops; repeated rhythmic loops; centered pendant; focal ornament; symmetry; long dangling elements; chains; bells; hooks; weapons; spikes; glowing parts; treasure or collectible cues; anything resembling a pickup or hazard; extra objects; soft gradients; subpixel texture; painterly rendering; concept-art rendering; 3D render; photorealism
